propositions: The T10 rubric must add a scope clause partitioning durable infrastructure from transient de-risk experiments near the top of the evaluation text.

A four-MAJOR-class safety qualifier must be placed immediately after the scope clause, preserving destructive-apply, wildcard-admin, plaintext-secret, and untrusted-endpoint protections for transient infrastructure.
A packaged eval spec with ten balanced cases (five pass, five finding) must demonstrate transient exclusion while protecting durable safety findings and preserving all four MAJOR safety classes.
Offline text-contract tests must lock the exact scope clause, exact co-located safety qualifier, and rubric independence without cross-criterion delegation.
The T10 rubric must not reference T15 or assign scope to other overlays, and must remain registered in NEW_SPECS with strict schema, scorer, and dataset validation.

Live agentic evaluation via rebar criteria eval T10 must correctly report pass for throwaway probes with scoped teardown, durable infrastructure, private-network transient IAM, secret-manager transient retrieval, and sandboxed teardown, and report finding for under-specified lifecycle, destructive transient apply, transient wildcard-admin, transient plaintext-secret, and untrusted-network transient services.
